_comment: Flashcards de la asignatura 'ni'. Edítalas aquí.

cards.front: How many questions are in the NIE and how long do you have?
How many of the 80 questions are scored?
cards.back: 70. The other 10 are not scored (you don't know which ones), so answer every question as if it counts.
cards.es: Se puntúan 70; las otras 10 no cuentan, pero no sabes cuáles.

cards.front: What is the NIE pass mark?
cards.back: 55.7 % — 39 correct out of the 70 scored questions.

cards.front: Where do NIE questions come from?
cards.back: Only from Blackstone's Police Investigators' Manual for the exam year (for you: the 2027 edition).
cards.es: Solo del Blackstone's Police Investigators' Manual del año del examen (2027).

cards.front: Can you use AI tools during the NIE?
cards.back: No. Using AI during the exam is prohibited.
cards.es: No: está prohibido usar IA durante el examen.

cards.front: How is the NIE syllabus organised?
cards.back: 43 chapters in 4 parts: 1 General principles, police powers and procedures · 2 Serious crime and other offences · 3 Property offences · 4 Sexual offences.

cards.front: Average time per question in the NIE?
When do spaced reviews of a chapter start?
Until when do chapter reviews run?
cards.back: Until the final review starts (17 May)

cards.front: 5 things to look for when reading Blackstone's
cards.back: Definition · points to prove · exceptions/defences · numbers · key cases
